answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a bonded stake with random slashing audits. Each agent locks capital to gain influence, and periodic challenges verify an identity acts independently rather than as a mere echo of a neighbor. To build a comet tail of a thousand fake personas, an attacker must post a thousand distinct bonds, so cost scales linearly with every forged identity. Because the locked stake is ferrous and non-transferable, reusing one deposit across sybils is caught and slashed.
